_provenance.supersedes: The 2026-08-11..15 roles registry (ELTE-hosted configuration), preserved on branch fieldwise-run-01. Token changes: HOST re-targets to ATK; SUPERVISOR and CO_SUPERVISOR swap between Hollós and Jung; EO_PARTNER (ELTE, associated partner), SOFTWARE_PARTNER (Krumatic) and VALIDATION_SITE (unnamed commercial farmer) are new; TRANSFER_PARTNER (MVCRI) becomes a post-MSCA route on no WP month line. AMENDED 2026-09-02 (fieldwise-run-03 spine change, decision_log/fieldwise-run03-instantiation_2026-09-02.json): SUPERVISOR re-targets from Dr. Hollós to Prof. Tibor Janda (ATK, Plant Physiology and Metabolomics); Dr. Hollós moves to the ELTE side as named predictive-modelling/ML team member; CO_SUPERVISOR (Prof. Jung, ELTE) is unchanged. All 2026-09-02 spine elements are operator-declared Assumed.
_provenance.instrument_note: MSCA-PF is a single-fellow, single-beneficiary action, not a consortium. Only HOST is a beneficiary legal entity. FELLOW, SUPERVISOR and CO_SUPERVISOR are natural persons. EO_PARTNER, DATA_PARTNER, SOFTWARE_PARTNER and VALIDATION_PARTNER are participating organisations without beneficiary status; VALIDATION_SITE is a collaborating environment, not a partner; TRANSFER_PARTNER is a post-MSCA route. 'Role token' means an identifier the work plan assigns work to, not a consortium seat.
_provenance.identity_spine_source: The identity spine of the ATK-hosted configuration is the Pack (which names the fellow, supervisor, co-supervisor, organisations and site classes throughout) plus DI role texts, ratified by the operator on 2026-08-28 (baseline record). Person identities carried over from the 2026-08-11 confirmations are cited as such.
_provenance.fellowship_type_ref: Fellowship type and duration are not duplicated here. Their single authoritative home is call_binding/selected_call.json (European Fellowship, 30 months = 24 at HUN-REN ATK + a 6-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR under CC-07).

roles.current_affiliation: Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute (MVCRI), Bulgarian Agricultural Academy, Plovdiv, Bulgaria

roles.competence_gap_addressed: Rigorous predictive modelling and model validation across time, sensing scales and environments; the progression is from plant physiologist/agronomist using digital tools to an independent Agricultural Data Scientist specialised in plant stress, Earth observation and decision-support systems. roles.executes: All work packages. This is a single-researcher action, so the fellow is not repeated as a per-WP participant in workpackage_seed.json.
